name: How long does a toilet replacement take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a toilet replacement take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most standard toilet replacements can be completed within 2 to 4 hours by a professional plumber. This includes removing the old toilet, preparing the flange, setting the new toilet, connecting the water supply, and testing for leaks. The duration can vary if there are unexpected plumbing issues, such as a damaged flange or complex water line adjustments. Alpha-Plumbing Services aims for efficient service to minimize disruption to your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: A standard toilet replacement typically takes 2 to 4 hours. Time may vary if unforeseen plumbing issues arise during installation.
